question: Which, if any, single remaining current-main policy-controlled transition has an unclosed observability gap, at least two natural completion paths and one minimal deterministic observation hook, so that identity-safe telemetry has measured decision value before another simulator row?
competingOptions: freeze at most one eligible transition surface for identity-safe observation-only telemetry
close this complete current-main missing-telemetry catalogue and continue with the next evidence-backed structural mechanism inside issue #421
record the audit as inconclusive at the preregistered cap

scientificBasis.measuredBottleneck: Removal refinement was broad and Afterimage-aliased; elite victory and no-HP-loss victory were near-universal; one-turn victory was too sparse. The missing discriminator must retain robust active, exact inactive, viable and package-independent policy identities on one frozen cohort.
scientificBasis.catalogueBeforeBehaviour: The catalogue is the exhaustive state-changing and policy-choice boundary of the immutable whole-run simulator after excluding surfaces already fully represented by the exact trace schema. It is frozen from source structure before any activation, target-card or outcome aggregate is read.
scientificBasis.mechanicalCounts: Completion paths, direct policy controls, telemetry fields and deterministic hooks are explicit finite lists. Deterministic code derives every gate count from list length; no manually copied numeric surface count can steer selection.
scientificBasis.cheapestDiscriminatingEvidence: Reuse only the 256 explicit-current trace rows already proved exactly identical to the 256 current-main baseline rows after observation labels are removed. The audit reads schema keys, not behavioural event counts, and opens no simulator process.
scientificBasis.claimBoundary: Selection authorises observation-only identity preflight, not a trigger, payoff, carrier, content candidate, package, detector claim, causal effect, ML, RL or optimiser.

catalogueBoundary.partialObservationRule: A terminal state field is not a complete event surface when it cannot identify completion source, time, multiplicity or an event later erased by removal. Partial observations are recorded but do not defeat an event-level observability gap.

eligibilityGates.provenance: Two natural paths prevent a single authored route from masquerading as a repertoire; two direct controls permit policy sensitivity; four fields are the exact minimal source, act and card identity envelope; one append hook is the identity-risk ceiling. All thresholds were frozen before behavioural counts and apply to every surface.

observationSurface.observation-only: Append only the selected four-field event at its exact successful completion; no state, choice, queue, RNG or result change.
observationSurface.status: Fixed absent in every cached row. This audit may authorise identity preflight only.

afterimagePayoff.status: A separate causal factor fixed independently from Scoreline and observation.

anchors: exact current-main source commit and blob hashes
exact baseline-versus-trace path, RNG, policy and result identity
zero protected-seed and zero new-ledger-row identity
designMatrix.expansionRule: A selected surface may receive only null-identity and focused mediator-isolation proof under a separate preregistration. No payoff, candidate, simulator row or joint cell is authorised. A later mechanism-blocked CRN must keep policies, simulation seeds, baseline, first-look budget, estimator and stopping rule equal and may add cross-package cells only after measured interference has decision value.

mechanisticallyJustifiedFutureInteractio: upgrade completion x a future upgrade payoff, because a payoff can occur only after a completed upgrade
upgrade completion x card acquisition policy, because the owned upgradeable set determines the target
upgrade completion x Scoreline use and upgrade completion x Afterimage use, because upgrading an anchor card may alter package activity
mechanisticInteractionsAndAliases.notEstimated: No interaction is estimated in this audit. Scoreline and Afterimage remain separate fixed factors with separate anchors.
mechanisticInteractionsAndAliases.catalogueAliases: Card acquisition is aliased to the closed existing-grammar acquisition iterations; non-boss relic acquisition is aliased to the completed exact current Dusk-favoured relic inventory and closures; removal is aliased to its complete two-route closure. Their source surfaces remain listed so aliasing cannot hide an omitted eligible path.
mechanisticInteractionsAndAliases.partialObservationAliases: Terminal deck up flags can undercount upgrades later removed and cannot distinguish rest from event or original upgrade from an upgraded duplicate. They cannot support source-specific or completion-count claims.
mechanisticInteractionsAndAliases.staging: Schema evidence may advance at most one observation surface to identity proof. No whole-run endpoint can be claimed for a factor that was not comparably evaluated on one frozen cohort.

scoreline.definition: Chisel precedes a later Faultline in the same fight in at least two of four rows.

afterimage.definition: Positive afterimageGuardDamage is recorded in at least two of four rows.

additionalMethodDecisionValue.rule: ML, RL or another optimiser can be considered only if no deterministic surface is eligible and at least two unaliased policy-controlled surfaces plus two fully trace-observed unaliased surfaces remain. Passing this rule would authorise only a separate preregistration, never execution here.

decisionRules.success: One or more surfaces pass unclosed, observability-gap, path-breadth, direct-policy-control, minimal-telemetry and single-hook gates; select exactly the first after ascending telemetry-field count, hook count and ID.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Freeze only the selected surface for a separate current-main identity-safe telemetry preregistration. First prove omitted and explicit-null exact path, RNG, policy, state and result identity on all 256 identities, then prove focused positive and negative controls affect only the intended observation. Implement no payoff or content and add no simulator row before that proof.
decisionRules.futility: No catalogued surface passes every frozen gate.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Close this complete current-main missing-telemetry catalogue and continue with the next evidence-backed structural mechanism inside issue #421. Do not subset a route, add a field, relax a gate, reopen an alias or rerun.
decisionRules.inconclusive: Immutable source, evidence, ledger or deterministic audit cannot complete before the wall-time cap.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Record the inconclusive result at the cap without implementation, simulator spend, trace extension, payoff, carrier, ML/RL or protected seeds.

methodBoundary: Deterministic Python owns immutable-input validation, catalogue checking, schema identity, list-derived counts, eligibility, selection and stop/go.
